card.name: Of after a share or 'most'
card.fires_on: The word 'of' or 'the' right after a percentage or 'Most' (e.g. '80% of', 'Most of the'), where a proportion of a group is about to be named. Also fires on some counts and tallies.

modes.label: Percent then of
modes.description: 'of' directly after a percentage, introducing the group the share refers to.
modes.example: found that 80%<< of>> elementary school children visit the nurse because of

modes.label: Most of the
modes.description: 'the' after 'Most of', before the group being counted.
modes.example: Most of<< the>> cases of liver injury are associated with the

modes.label: Counts and records
modes.description: A position inside a number or tally, such as a win-loss record or a goal total.

card.writes: It promotes words for quantity and majority such as 'most', 'total' and 'numerous', so the next words describe how many or what share.
card.plain: It marks the spot after 'most of' or a percentage where the text is about to say which group is meant.
